en: A sepia-toned illustrated postcard depicting a narrow cobblestone street flanked by tall, old residential buildings with wooden shutters on the windows. A curved streetlamp extends over the lane, and at the end of the street stands a house with a tiled roof and small rooftop chimneys. The scene evokes a quiet, historical European town. No visible printed text or caption appears on the front.
